output.answer: Only engineering/opencode.md mentions the probe check count, in its "What production taught (agent-gateway, 2.0.25 → 2.0.32)" section under Pinning: agw runs an npm install at OPENCODE_PINNED_VERSION, one binary serves the whole machine, Homebrew's copy is removed, and scripts/opencode-v2-probe.ts (60 checks) gates each bump. The number is 60. The other cited notes (engineering/projects/agent-gateway.md, engineering/projects/dotfiles.md, engineering/remote-terminal-transport.md) mention no probe and no check count — they only say "pinned 2.0.32", "one pinned build", and the mosh dependency-pin lesson — so the figure is single-sourced in the wiki.
